_comment: FETAN roles and the permissions each one holds.
Two things are achieved here at once:
1. Granting what a role needs.
2. WITHHOLDING everything else — this is how unused Mifos modules (groups,
centres, collection sheets, remittances, investors, surveys) are hidden.
The frontend hides what the user lacks permission for, and the backend
refuses the call regardless, so nothing is deleted from the codebase.
Permission syntax:
"APPROVE_LOAN"                  exact permission code
"READ_*"                        prefix wildcard
"grouping:transaction_savings"  every permission in a grouping
ALL_FUNCTIONS_READ is reserved for Management and Auditor (oversight / read-all).
Operational roles get curated READ_* + write permissions so FETAN menus can be
gated by action (CREATE_CLIENT, APPROVE_LOAN, DISBURSE_LOAN, etc.).
⚠️ IMPORTANT — this version of Fineract has NO per-action checker permissions
(no APPROVE_LOAN_CHECKER). The ability to check another user's pending action is
granted by the single special permission CHECKER_SUPER_USER, which allows
checking ANY pending command, not just loan approvals. Splitting the committee
into a Maker role and a Checker role is therefore how two-person control is
enforced — see the note in README.md.

roles.name: FETAN Employee
roles.description: Front-office staff: onboard members, capture loan applications, take deposits. Cannot approve or disburse.
permissions: READ_FETAN Member Demographics by Age Band

roles.name: FETAN Loan Committee (Maker)
roles.description: Committee member who initiates the approval decision. With maker-checker enabled, this records a PENDING approval that another user must check.

roles.name: FETAN Loan Committee (Checker)
roles.description: Committee member who confirms another member's pending decision. The check is what actually applies the approval.

roles.name: FETAN Management
roles.description: Oversight: full visibility plus reporting. No transactional authority by default.

roles.name: FETAN Teller
roles.description: Cash desk: drawer management, deposits, withdrawals and repayments.

roles.name: FETAN Auditor
roles.description: Read-only across the whole system, including the audit trail. Cannot change anything.

_usersComment: Test users, one per role, for walking the loan chain end to end (Phase 2).
⚠️ These are DEVELOPMENT credentials for the local stack only. The password is
set from the SEED_USER_PASSWORD environment variable; users are skipped entirely
if it is not set, so a production run cannot create them by accident.
